info.title: Electoral systems simulation API
info.description: Local teaching server executing the same Python counting algorithms shown in the chapters. Start it with `python3 python/server.py`. GitHub Pages hosts documentation only. Results include intermediate counts; a tie remains a set of co-winners. See the API guide for exact variants, tie priorities, and computational limits.

post.summary: Count ballots using a named method
post.description: Ballot counts repeat identical voters; they are not score multipliers selected by voters. Candidate array order is the fixed priority for internal ties. Complete rankings are required for ranked methods. Two-round uses a fixed-preference simulation, not a second voter survey. Seeded lotteries return both a sampled winner and its distribution.

200.description: Executed count, final co-winners or sampled winner, and method-specific trace.

400.description: Invalid JSON, method, ballot, option, or profile.

413.description: Request body or computation exceeds a published teaching limit.

tie.description: True when the final result contains multiple co-winners.

Election.description: Use the ballot format accepted by the chosen method. Rankings must list every candidate exactly once. Score and credit maps must include every candidate. Additional numeric and computation limits are documented in the API guide and enforced by the server.
